elements.name: init
elements.brief: Initialize the wave simulation. Call it once before any other wave
elements.description:
Initialize the wave simulation. Call it once before any other wave
function, with the same parameters the water shader uses.

parameters.name: wave1_direction
parameters.doc: Wave 1 direction (0.0 to 2.0, multiplied by π internally).

parameters.name: gameobject_capacity
parameters.doc: Pre-allocated entity table size (for example 256), fixed at init time.

elements.name: add_gameobject
elements.brief: Add a floating game object to the wave simulation.
elements.description:
Add a floating game object to the wave simulation.

The model must face -Z in its unrotated state: wave sampling, pitch, roll
and movement all assume it. To face another way at runtime, call
`set_yaw` after registration, or pass the matching `forward`.

parameters.name: float_offset
parameters.doc: Vertical offset from the water surface.

parameters.name: water_base_y
parameters.doc: Y coordinate of the flat water plane.

parameters.name: sample_distance
parameters.doc: Probe offset used to compute the pitch and roll normals.

parameters.name: rotation_smoothing
parameters.doc: SLERP factor: `0` or omitted disables rotation, `1` snaps instantly.

parameters.name: use_world_transform
parameters.doc: `true` for objects nested under another moving object, `false` for root objects.

parameters.name: forward
parameters.doc: World-space direction the model's nose faces at registration. Default is `vmath.vector3(0, 0, -1)`.

returnvalues.doc: The floater ID used by every later call, or `0` on error such as exceeded capacity.

elements.name: update_wave1
elements.brief: Live-update the wave 1 parameters. Call it in sync with the water
elements.description:
Live-update the wave 1 parameters. Call it in sync with the water
shader's wave 1 update to keep visuals and physics aligned.

elements.name: update_wave2
elements.brief: Live-update the wave 2 parameters. Call it in sync with the water
elements.description:
Live-update the wave 2 parameters. Call it in sync with the water
shader's wave 2 update to keep visuals and physics aligned.

elements.name: get_wave1_height
elements.brief: Sample the wave 1 height at a world position, at the simulation's
elements.description:
Sample the wave 1 height at a world position, at the simulation's
current time.

parameters.name: time
parameters.doc: Required by the runtime; the sample uses the simulation's own clock instead.

elements.name: get_wave2_height
elements.brief: Sample the wave 2 height at a world position, at the simulation's
elements.description:
Sample the wave 2 height at a world position, at the simulation's
current time.

parameters.name: time
parameters.doc: Required by the runtime; the sample uses the simulation's own clock instead.

elements.name: set_yaw
elements.brief: Override the yaw (heading) of a floater, for steering such as a boat
elements.description:
Override the yaw (heading) of a floater, for steering such as a boat
turning.

elements.name: move
elements.brief: Begin moving a floater forward at up to `max_speed`, accelerating by
elements.description:
Begin moving a floater forward at up to `max_speed`, accelerating by
`speed_factor` per second.

parameters.name: max_speed
parameters.doc: Target and maximum speed in world units per second.

parameters.name: speed_factor
parameters.doc: Acceleration factor; higher ramps up faster.

elements.name: stop
elements.brief: Stop a floater. Its target speed becomes `0` and it decelerates smoothly
elements.description:
Stop a floater. Its target speed becomes `0` and it decelerates smoothly
by its speed factor.

elements.name: pause
elements.brief: Pause or resume the wave update loop without removing entities.
elements.description: Pause or resume the wave update loop without removing entities.

elements.name: is_pause
elements.brief: Whether the wave update loop is paused.
elements.description: Whether the wave update loop is paused.

elements.name: shutdown
elements.brief: Shut down the wave simulation and free all resources. The extension
elements.description:
Shut down the wave simulation and free all resources. The extension
finalizer calls it automatically; call it yourself only to
reinitialize.
